arxiv-2110-13259.title: Active Learning for Deep Visual Tracking
arxiv-2110-13259.creator: Di Yuan, Xiaojun Chang, Yi Yang, Qiao Liu, Dehua Wang, Zhenyu He
arxiv-2110-13259.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been successfully applied to the single target tracking task in recent years. Generally, training a deep CNN model requires numerous labeled training samples, and the number and quality of these samples directly affect the representational capability of the trained model.

arxiv-2206-04095.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Joshua V. Shields, Wolfgang Kerzendorf, Matthew W. Hosek Jr, Ken J. Shen, Armin Rest, Tuan Do, Jessica R. Lu, Andrew G. Fullard, Giovanni Strampelli, Alfredo Zenteno. Type Ia Supernovae (SNe Ia) are securely understood to come from the thermonuclear explosion of a white dwarf as a result of binary interaction, but the nature of that binary interaction and the secondary object is uncertain.

arxiv-2211-14559.title: Boosting COVID-19 Severity Detection with Infection-aware Contrastive Mixup Classification
arxiv-2211-14559.creator: Junlin Hou, Jilan Xu, Nan Zhang, Yuejie Zhang*, Xiaobo Zhang*, Rui Feng*
arxiv-2211-14559.description: Abstract This paper presents our solution for the 2nd COVID-19 Severity Detection Competition. This task aims to distinguish the Mild, Moderate, Severe, and Critical grades in COVID-19 chest CT images. In our approach, we devise a novel infection-aware 3D Contrastive Mixup Classification network for severity grading.

arxiv-2401-17230.title: ESPnet-SPK: full pipeline speaker embedding toolkit with reproducible recipes, self-supervised front-ends, and off-the-shelf models
arxiv-2401-17230.creator: Jee-weon Jung, Wangyou Zhang, Jiatong Shi, Zakaria Aldeneh, Takuya Higuchi, Alex Gichamba, Barry-John Theobald, Ahmed Hussen Abdelaziz, Shinji Watanabe
arxiv-2401-17230.description: Abstract This paper introduces ESPnet-SPK, a toolkit designed for training and utilizing speaker embedding extractors. It offers an open-source platform, facilitating effortless construction of models ranging from the x-vector to the SKA-TDNN, thanks to its modular architecture that simplifies the development of variants.

arxiv-2411-09678.title: NeuralDEM – Real-time Simulation of Industrial Particulate Flows
arxiv-2411-09678.creator: Benedikt Alkin, Tobias Kronlachner, Samuele Papa, Stefan Pirker, Thomas Lichtenegger, Johannes Brandstetter
arxiv-2411-09678.description: Abstract † † This work is a preprint. † † † ~{}^{\dagger} core contributor, ∗ ~{}^{*} equal contribution, ‡ ~{}^{\ddagger} work done during internship. † † @ Correspondence to: brandstetter@ml.jku.at , johannes@emmi.ai Advancements in computing power have made it possible to numerically simulate large-scale fluid-mechanical and/or particulate systems, many of which are integral to core industrial processes.

arxiv-2506-11649.title: The Darkfield Approach to Measuring Vacuum Birefringence and Light-by-Light Couplings A Proof-of-Principle Experiment
arxiv-2506-11649.creator: Michal Šmíd, Pooyan Khademi, Michal Andrzejewski, Carsten Bähtz, Erik Brambrink, Tomáš Burian, Jakub Bulička, Samuele Di Dio Cafiso, Jindřich Chalupský, Thomas E. Cowan, Sebastian Göde, Jörg Grenzer, Věra Hájková, Peter Hilz, Willi Hippler, Hauke Höppner, Alžběta Horynová, Lingen Huang, Oliver Humph
arxiv-2506-11649.description: Abstract Vacuum fluctuations give rise to effective nonlinear interactions between electromagnetic fields. These generically modify the characteristics of light traversing a strong-field region. X-ray free-electron lasers (XFELs) constitute a particularly promising probe, due to their brilliance, the possibility of precise control and favourable frequency scaling.

arxiv-2508-11931.title: An Improved Algorithm for Adversarial Linear Contextual Bandits via Reduction
arxiv-2508-11931.creator: Tim van Erven, Jack Mayo, Julia Olkhovskaya, Chen-Yu Wei
arxiv-2508-11931.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tim van Erven, Jack Mayo, Julia Olkhovskaya, Chen-Yu Wei. We present an efficient algorithm for linear contextual bandits with adversarial losses and stochastic action sets. Our approach reduces this setting to misspecification-robust adversarial linear bandits with fixed action sets.

Any affiliations are for identif
arxiv-2509-01346.creator: Ozan Hur
arxiv-2509-01346.description: Abstract We study the worst-case probability that Y Y outperforms a benchmark X X when the law of Y Y lies in a Kullback-Leibler neighbourhood of the benchmark. The max–min problem over couplings admits a tractable dual (via optimal transport), whose optimiser is an exponential tilt of the benchmark law.

arxiv-2510-04400.title: Large Language Models Preserve Semantic Isotopies in Story Continuations
arxiv-2510-04400.creator: Marc Cavazza
arxiv-2510-04400.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the relevance of textual semantics to Large Language Models (LLM), extending previous insights into the connection between distributional semantics and structural semantics. We investigate whether LLM-generated texts preserve semantic isotopies. We design a story continuation experiment using 10,000 ROCStories prompts completed by five LLMs.

arxiv-2601-20256.creator: Xuanyu Su, Diana Inkpen, Nathalie Japkowicz
arxiv-2601-20256.description: Abstract . Online hate on social media ranges from overt slurs and threats ( hard hate speech ) to soft hate speech : discourse that appears reasonable on the surface but uses framing and value-based arguments to steer audiences toward blaming or excluding a target group.

bronte-the-professor-1857.title: The Professor
bronte-the-professor-1857.creator: Charlotte Brontë
bronte-the-professor-1857.description: Brontë's first-written, posthumously published novel; the seedbed of Villette and Jane Eyre, essential for understanding her development.

openalex-w7212145785.title: EDUCAÇÃO EM SAÚDE BUCAL COM AGENTES COMUNITÁRIOS DE SAÚDE NO TERRITÓRIO DO SISAL, BAHIA: RELATO DE EXPERIÊNCIA
openalex-w7212145785.creator: Hamilton Santana Brito, Júlia Silva Ferreira, Mércia Oliveira de Carvalho, Juarez Carlos Passos Nogueira, Alana Moreira da Silva, Ana Áurea Alécio de Oliveira Rodrigues
openalex-w7212145785.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7212145785.description: O Agente Comunitário de Saúde (ACS) exerce papel estratégico na promoção da saúde, mas ainda apresenta insegurança diante de demandas específicas da saúde bucal. Este relato descreve uma experiência extensionista realizada no ano de 2022–2023, pelo Programa de Educação Tutorial...

plos-pone-0004590.title: Improved Learning and Memory in Aged Mice Deficient in Amyloid β-Degrading Neutral Endopeptidase
plos-pone-0004590.creator: Thomas Walther, Doris Albrecht, Matthias Becker et al.
plos-pone-0004590.description: PLOS ONE research article. Neutral endopeptidase, also known as neprilysin and abbreviated NEP, is considered to be one of the key enzymes in initial human amyloid-β (Aβ) degradation. The aim of our study was to explore the impact of NEP deficiency on the initial development of dementia-like symptoms in mi

pmc-10601151.title: Academic contributions to the development of evidence and policy systems: an EPPI Centre collective autoethnography
pmc-10601151.creator: Sandy Oliver, Kelly Dickson, Mukdarut Bangpan
pmc-10601151.description: BackgroundEvidence for policy systems emerging around the world combine the fields of research synthesis, evidence-informed policy and public engagement with research. We conducted this retrospective collective autoethnography to understand the role of academics in developing such systems.MethodsWe constructed a timeline of EPPI Centre work and associated events since 1990.

pmc-11389423.title: Integration of 3D printing and case-based learning in clinical practice for the treatment of developmental dysplasia of the hip
pmc-11389423.creator: Shuo Feng, Ying-Jin Sun, Qi-Rui Zhu, Si-Feng Shi, Yong-Shuo Zhang, Feng Yuan
pmc-11389423.description: BackgroundCase-based learning (CBL) utilizing three-dimensional (3D) printed hip joint models is a problem-solving teaching method that combines the tactile and visual advantages of 3D-printed models with CBL. This study aims to investigate the impact of integrating 3D printing with CBL on learning developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH).

pmc-11392302.title: Comparison between the Efficacy and Tolerability of Polyvinylpyrrolidone-Iodine Eye Drops 0.6% and 1% in Adenoviral Keratoconjunctivitis: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-11392302.creator: Ali Makateb, Mahdi Soleymanzadeh, Saeed Soleiman-Meigooni, Ali Asgari, Mohammad Reza Etemadi, Amir Reza Mafi, Nader Mohammadi
pmc-11392302.description: Purpose:To investigate the effect of topical Polyvinylpyrrolidone-iodine (PVP-I) 0.6% on the clinical course of adenoviral keratoconjunctivitis compared with PVP-I 1% and artificial tears.Methods:We prospectively enrolled all patients over 18 years of age with a polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-confirmed diagnosis of adenoviral keratoconjunctivitis who presented to the hospital between November 2022 and June 2023.

pmc-11487323.title: Identifying and presenting key country-specific indicators related to medication adherence: a comprehensive study across European countries
pmc-11487323.creator: Tamás Ágh, Kristina Garuolienė, Anne Gerd Granas, João Gregório, Nilay Aksoy, Nataliia Khanyk, Maja Ortner Hadžiabdić, Przemyslaw Kardas, Emma Aarnio
pmc-11487323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study tackles the critical challenge of medication non-adherence in healthcare by pinpointing indicators related to medication adherence (IRMAs) across 39 European countries and Israel. Utilizing a structured expert survey methodology within the European Network to Advance Best Practices and Technology on Medication Adherence (ENABLE; COST Action CA19132), our research identified key country-specific IRMAs and collected data on these indicators to understand the multifaceted nature of medication adherence.

pmc-11527836.title: Necrotizing fasciitis resembled acute coronary syndrome: A case report
pmc-11527836.creator: Matin Sepehrinia, Faeze Yousefi, Adib Valibeygi, Abdulhakim Alkamel
pmc-11527836.description: Key Clinical MessageChest pain is a frequent complaint in emergency departments, with various differential diagnoses from benign to life‐threatening. Hereby, we described a 60‐year‐old man presented with chest pain and hypotension who initially misdiagnosed as acute coronary syndrome, but was ultimately diagnosed with necrotizing fasciitis. This case highlights the importance of considering rare causes of chest pain.

pmc-12396965.title: On the role of interface strategy in multi-scale hybrid additive manufacturing
pmc-12396965.creator: Alan Burl, Zaky Hussein, Venkata Surya Karthik Adapa, Melissa Foley, Nicole Van Handel, Matthew McCoy, Thomas Kurfess, Christopher Saldaña, Kyle Saleeby
pmc-12396965.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As multiple macro scale directed energy deposition (DED) processes begin to be industrially adopted for large scale component manufacture, it is imperative that interface strategies between the processes are fully understood. The present work investigates the asynchronous deposition of a wire component (DED-arc), followed by a powder-based deposition (DED-LP) with varying surface treatments which were evaluated for flatness, porosity, hardness, and Charpy impact energy.

pmc-12593313.title: A Sensitivity Analysis Framework Using the Proxy Pattern–Mixture Model for Generalization of Experimental Results
pmc-12593313.creator: Rebecca R Andridge, Ruoqi Song, Brady T West
pmc-12593313.description: Generalizing findings from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to a target population is challenging when unmeasured factors influence both trial participation and outcomes. We propose a novel sensitivity analysis framework to assess the impact of such unmeasured factors on treatment effect estimates called the Proxy Pattern‐Mixture Model in the context of RCTs (RCT‐PPMM).

pmc-12647641.title: Quantum-enhanced artificial potential field method for robust drone swarm shape formation
pmc-12647641.creator: Ihab Almaameri, László Blázovics
pmc-12647641.description: Distributed coordination of a swarm of drones is one of the inherent open problems in autonomous aerial robotics, as classical approaches suffer from slow convergence and poor resilience to disturbances. In this paper, an efficient and robust approach to shape formation of drone swarms is offered based on Quantum-Enhanced Artificial Potential Field (QEAPF).

pmc-12784485.title: User experience with two computerized cognitive intervention programs for people with mild cognitive impairment
pmc-12784485.creator: Julia-Sophia Scheuermann, Elmar Graessel, Martin Schmitt, Petra Scheerbaum
pmc-12784485.description: BackgroundComputerized cognitive training (CCT) is effective for people with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). But CCT must be “user friendly” and easy to handle for this target group.ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to evaluate in a secondary data analysis the user experience with two CCT programs developed for people with MCI.

pmc-13105922.title: Association between spexin and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13105922.creator: Xin Sun, Jiayi Yao, Jinsong Kuang, Caihong Xin
pmc-13105922.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAccumulating evidence suggests that spexin is implicated in cellular energy balance, glucose and lipid metabolism, appetite suppression, and water-electrolyte regulation, and is closely associated with metabolic conditions including obesity, hyperglycemia, and hyperlipidemia.

pmc-13188280.title: Operational strategies among infectious disease clinical trial sites during pandemics: a scoping review
pmc-13188280.creator: K. L. Trigg, A. Zhang, A. W. Wu
pmc-13188280.description: PurposeThe aim of this study is to examine documented strategies, challenges, and lessons related to clinical trial site operations during pandemics.MethodsThis review focused on seven major pandemics: COVID-19, HIV/AIDS, Ebola, SARS, MERS, H1N1, and Zika. Searches were conducted using PubMed and Embase between September 2024 and February 2025, yielding 7572 unique records.

pmc-13254918.title: Magneto-electrochemical approach for determining the rate-controlling step for corrosion of iron in ferric solutions
pmc-13254918.creator: Haiying Dong, Fujie Zhou, Xiujie Wang, Zhanpeng Lu, Tongming Cui, Xin Li, Juan Wang, Xinhe Xu, Junjie Chen, Tetsuo Shoji
pmc-13254918.description: The rate-controlling step for the corrosion of iron in ferric solutions is determined by electrochemical measurements under a magnetic field. A positive shift in open circuit potential and the increase of cathodic current by imposing a magnetic field indicate that the contribution of the mass transport process of reactive species to rate control.

pmc-13314904.title: Associations between eating jetlag and adiposity in preschool children, and the moderating roles of social jetlag and chronotype
pmc-13314904.creator: Mirkka Maukonen, Anna M. Ruokolahti, Josefine Björkqvist, Henna Launistola, Jenna Rahkola, Ilse Tillman, Henna Vepsäläinen, Carola Ray, Eva Roos, Maijaliisa Erkkola, Reetta Lehto
pmc-13314904.description: PurposeEating jetlag (variation in eating times between weekdays and weekends) may increase obesity risk in adults, but studies in children are lacking. The potential moderating roles of social jetlag (SJL, variation in sleep timing between weekdays and weekends) and chronotype (an individual’s intrinsic circadian rhythm) also remain unclear.

pmc-13363186.title: Characterization of Powder Bed Fusion–Laser Beam Ti6Al4V Samples in the As-Built and Stress-Relief States
pmc-13363186.creator: Paola Leo, Gilda Renna, Andrea Amleto De Luca, Chiara Scaramuzzi, Neetesh Soni, Francesco Willem Panella, Teresa Primo, Gabriele Papadia
pmc-13363186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite the advantages of powder bed fusion–laser beam (PBF-LB), Ti6Al4V components often exhibit high yield strength but limited ductility, which restricts their use in critical structural applications. This study aims to identify the most effective heat treatment to optimize the strength–ductility balance in Ti6Al4V parts produced by PBF-LB and to establish direct correlations between microstructural states, mechanical properties and corrosion behavior.

pmc-13494552.title: A computational method to design broad-spectrum T cell-inducing vaccines applied to Betacoronaviruses
pmc-13494552.creator: Phil Palmer, Sofiya Fedosyuk, Srivatsan Parthasarathy, Jonathan Holbrook, Charlotte George, Laura O’Reilly, Lara Wiegand, George William Carnell, Jonathan Luke Heeney, Sneha Vishwanath
pmc-13494552.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryAntigenically diverse pathogens such as coronaviruses pose substantial global health threats, highlighting the need for broad-spectrum vaccines. Here, we introduce Spectravax, a computational method that designs broad-spectrum vaccines accounting for genetic diversity in both host and pathogen populations. Using Spectravax, we designed a nucleocapsid (N) antigen to elicit cross-reactive immune responses to viruses from the Sarbecovirus and Merbecovirus subgenera of Betacoronaviruses. In silico analyses demonstrated superior predicted host and pathogen coverage for Spectravax compared to wild-type sequences and existing computational designs.
